story.title: The Portrait's Price
story.logline: An aging artist discovers that her hyper-realistic paintings literally age the subjects in real life, forcing her to paint her own masterpiece.
story.theme: The true cost of capturing perfection.
story.twist: The subject she is currently painting is not a model, but her own reflection in a giant mirror.
story.ending: If beauty demands a sacrifice, whose face will be left blank on the canvas?

scenes.narration: My paintings never just capture a face. They capture time, stealing the youth right off the canvas.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close up of 25-year-old female artist Clara, messy dark hair, paint-stained oversized gray hoodie, in a dim cluttered studio.
scenes.camera: Extreme close up on eyes, slow push in.

scenes.narration: Yesterday I painted old Mr. Vance with deep wrinkles. Today, he woke up looking exactly like the portrait.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, dark hair, paint-stained gray hoodie, holding a glowing oil painting of an old man in her dark studio.
scenes.camera: Medium shot, tracking left to right.

scenes.narration: Everyone called it a miraculous curse. I called it a terrifying power I could finally use.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, dark hair, paint-stained gray hoodie, staring wide-eyed at her canvas with a wicked, ambitious grin.

scenes.narration: I mixed vibrant crimsons and smooth golds, desperate to paint myself the flawless youth I always wanted.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, dark hair, paint-stained gray hoodie, frantically mixing bright paints on a wooden palette under a spotlight.

scenes.narration: Every brushstroke felt lighter. Every painted curve smoothed away the harsh realities of my tiring life.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, dark hair, paint-stained gray hoodie, sweeping a fine brush across a glowing canvas with intense focus.
scenes.camera: Close up on hands and brush.

scenes.narration: I added the final shining highlight to the cheekbones, stepping back to admire my absolute masterpiece.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, dark hair, paint-stained gray hoodie, stepping back slowly, wiping sweat from her forehead in the studio.

scenes.narration: The canvas glowed with radiant life. But a strange, sudden chill swept through the quiet studio room.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, dark hair, paint-stained gray hoodie, shivering as dust motes freeze in the air around the glowing canvas.

scenes.narration: I turned around to look in the heavy floor-length mirror, expecting to see my gorgeous new face.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, dark hair, paint-stained gray hoodie, turning abruptly toward a tall, ornate mirror covered in dust.

scenes.narration: The mirror showed only an empty, blank canvas staring back at me with terrifying, hollow eyes.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, dark hair, paint-stained gray hoodie, staring in absolute horror at a mirror reflecting a blank white canvas.

scenes.narration: If beauty demands a sacrifice, whose face will be left completely blank on the canvas?
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, dark hair, paint-stained gray hoodie, fading into transparency while standing beside the glowing finished portrait.
scenes.camera: Extreme wide shot, fading to black.

caption.hook: Every brushstroke steals a year of life.
caption.title: The Portrait's Price
caption.caption: She thought her hyper-realistic art was pure genius, until the wrinkles in the paint appeared on her living models. Now, facing the canvas with a mirror in hand, she realizes her final masterpiece has only one subject left.
